title: Anti-drug activist murder: Diljit Dosanjh says Jhota's family should get justice
summary: Known for raising his voice against the illegal sale of addictive substances at chemist shops, Parvinder Singh Jhota was shot in broad daylight inside a medical store in a busy marketplace in Mansa on October 13

title: Hyderabad airport regains X account access after cryptocurrency promotion posts by hackers
summary: At around 1.30 a.m., the airport’s X handle, ‘@RGIAHyd’, published posts promoting ‘StonkFun Season 1’, an eligibility checker linked to the Stonk App and the Solana cryptocurrency ecosystem.

title: Thousands witness Cauvery Theerthodbhava at Talacauvery
Indian air ambulance makes emergency landing in Bangladesh; patient dies

title: CM Vijay’s negligence is costing lives, alleges M.K. Stalin

title: Government asks Meta to ensure its recommendation systems do not expose users to limited set of narratives
